data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 claims incurred, net of reinsurance, in the technical account of GBP 145,382k (2013: GBP 135,871k) includes GBP 34,490k (2013: GBP 51,518k) of releases in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 546.743m. The Syndicate reports net releases in respect of prior accident years of GBP 34.49m (reported as part of claims incurred, net of reinsurance), reflecting favourable claims development and a year of low catastrophe activity together with disciplined underwriting and claims management. Per-class movements in net technical provisions show releases in Property and Motor but strengthening in Casualty, Marine and Treaty business.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 34,490k (2013: GBP 51,518k) of releases in respect of prior accident years
The Syndicate was not significantly impacted by any notable industry losses in 2014 except in Aviation

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding was found. The only quantified prior-year movement stated was a NET release of GBP 34,490k (note 13) which has been used as a fallback (NET of reinsurance - no gross figure available). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior-year comparative). Per-LOB movements are derived from changes in the net technical provisions table (2013 -> 2014) and therefore represent NET movements, not gross, and have been mapped to standard LOB names where appropriate. No claims development triangle was provided in the extracted pages.
